title: Fix the three unchanged-test flakes that fail the full gate: pg-pool teardown 57P01 race, report-job-failure concurrent-creator oracle, dispatch consecutive type-check deadline

outcomes.statement: The full gate (pnpm check, turbo forced, default package and file parallelism) passes on an unchanged tree without the three load-dependent failures, so no story re-runs it until green and the US-069 RULING-20 serial scheduling is retired.
outcomes.demo: Run pnpm check with TURBO_FORCE=true ten consecutive times on one committed candidate; all ten exit 0. Record full-gate wall time before (RULING-20 serial shape on unchanged main) and after (default parallelism on the candidate).

uncertainties.statement: Whether the 57P01 race reproduces deterministically enough for a RED test (US-067 could not force the exact full-suite interleave).
uncertainties.resolution: The mechanism is confirmed in pg-pool 3.14.0: Pool.end() calls client.end() without awaiting it and resolves once its client list is empty, while each idle client keeps the pool's idle error listener, which re-emits on a pool that has no error listener. The RED test widens the window (many idle clients per pool, end() then stop() immediately, repeated) and records pool errors through an attached listener; the observed RED rate on the unchanged fixture is recorded, never assumed. The fix drains: stop() waits until no client backend remains on the database before pg_terminate_backend, which then reaches only genuine leaks.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the full gate is meaningful when run ten times on an unchanged tree.
uncertainties.resolution: Turbo's shared cache would replay runs 2-10, so every run uses TURBO_FORCE=true; logs, exit codes and wall times go to the session scratchpad and the tree stays committed and unchanged for the whole loop.

uncertainties.statement: Mutation routing of the fixture source.
uncertainties.resolution: scripts/mutation-scope.mjs EXCLUDED matches (^|/)testing/ and *.test.ts, so postgres-container.ts and the three test files are not mutatable: zero shards, zero previews, no cold campaign, no test_report.
